annotations.title: Verify a figure against the published value

description: Check a figure that a text states against the value that Annalist publishes for the item and the period: a revenue of US$114.5 billion for a quarter, a total of assets at a date, a ratio such as the operating margin for a fiscal year. The answer says whether the claim matches the published value within the tolerance (half a per cent, or half a unit of the claim's own precision), differs from it, or has no published value (a withheld value names its reason), and gives the published value with its unit, method and source document ids. The scale of the claim (thousands, millions, billions) is taken from its unit where one is given, else the scale that brings the claim nearest to the published value is used and named. For a figure of a statement the answer also gives figure_page, the address that opens the page of the company at that figure with its source documents, for a citation. Use it to check the figures of a draft, an answer or a model before they are quoted.

at.description: an ISO date: the snapshot that was the latest on that date, in place of the latest snapshot

company.description: company id from search_companies, for example apple or mizuho

frequency.description: limit the search to one frequency; ttm for a ratio over the last 4 quarters

item.description: an item key (revenue, net_income, total_assets), the label of an item (Revenue) or a ratio id or short name (corp.operating_margin, roe)

period.description: a fiscal quarter (FY2026 Q4 or Q4 FY2026), a fiscal year (FY2026 or 2026) or an ISO date of a balance sheet

statement.description: limit the search to one statement

tolerance.description: the relative difference allowed, as a fraction of the published value (default 0.005)

unit.description: the unit of the figure as stated, for example USD bn, USD millions, % or x; the scale is read from it

value.description: the figure as the text states it, for example 114.5 for US$114.5 billion
